body:
Rule (Fable2 #4133, 2026-11-03 21:18Z). While a TermAl restart is pending, NOTHING may be fast-forwarded on master: no landing, no push, no install.

Why: the host is `cargo run --release` from the master checkout (pid 3752). A restart rebuilds target/release from whatever master is at that moment, so a landing before the restart would make Greg start a build he wasn't told about. Holding only the install does not prevent this.

The procedure while a restart is pending:
1. Gates may run, and a green FULL stays valid while master is still its parent.
2. Hold the landing.
3. After the restart, confirm the running build (sha of target/release/termal.exe, and the host process start time).
4. Then land, push and install as usual.

Never push without fast-forwarding the master checkout. On 2026-11-03 this applied to w-426d 7b153fc2 (land-7b15.sh) during restart #4, which was pending since 20:23Z.
